body:
This looks very odd to say the least.

@mkouba could you have a look?
I've tried the reproducer locally and it seems that the HTTP server is stuck if `quarkus.http.insecure-requests=disabled` is used. We'll need to investigate this further.

issue.title: VertxHttpRecorder fix - startup gets stuck if insecure-requests=disabled
issue.body:
- resolves #8336
- also skip the http part in the "Listening on..." log message when
quarkus.http.insecure-requests=disabled

body: @gsmet So it seems that `quarkus.http.insecure-requests=disabled` actually never worked. I've sent a PR with a minimal fix. @ddewalle it would be great if you could test the PR.

> @gsmet So it seems that `quarkus.http.insecure-requests=disabled` actually never worked. I've sent a PR with a minimal fix. @ddewalle it would be great if you could test the PR.

I tested the PR, merging the modifications of VertxHttpRecorder.java in top of extensions/vertx-http/runtime with latest Quarkus 1.3.1.Final tag.
I only rebuilt quarkus-vertx-http-1.3.1.Final.jar locally and executed the bug reproducer (with Java 11) -> the bug seems to be fixed and the Quatkus Ascii logo is back too ;-)

I also tested the fix on a real project with multi quarkus servers communicating with each others (non-native mode) with Quarkus 1.3.1.Final and Java 14 and the bug seems to be fixed too.
Well done :-)
